description: This file is a shell script testing the behavior of Git commands when handling missing commit objects, including setup steps, intentional object removal, and verification of failure conditions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a test repository, creates multiple commits with tags, and deletes a specific object to simulate a missing commit.

methods.name: check corruption
methods.description: Runs 'git fsck' expecting it to fail due to the missing object.

methods.name: rev-list notices corruption (1)
methods.description: Checks 'git rev-list' with commit graph disabled, expecting failure due to corruption.

methods.name: rev-list notices corruption (2)
methods.description: Checks 'git rev-list --objects' with commit graph disabled, expecting failure.

methods.name: pack-objects notices corruption
methods.description: Tests 'git pack-objects' command expecting it to fail when processing a corrupted pack.
